fact: The World Bank's completion report says 98 percent of beneficiaries of the five main poverty-targeted social programmes were updated in the Single Social Registry by March 2025, against a 75.8 percent target.
The World Bank review says the social registry is linked to the national ID system (OMANG) for validation; no date is given for the link, so the document's published date (2022) is used.
The World Bank review says beneficiary data for at least five programmes was digitised into the social registry in four districts and uploaded in six districts by May 2021.
